FAQ

Questions,
answered

The short version. Every product and solution page goes into more detail.

Visit the help center
What is HubEngage?

HubEngage is the workforce OS for frontline and distributed teams: one app for communications, operations, knowledge and engagement, with HubEngage Intelligence automating the work across all four.

Is it really free to start?

Yes. The Free plan covers up to 50 people and includes a 30-day trial of every Standard feature. If you stop paying later, anything you built is kept, never deleted.

Do we have to replace the systems we already use?

No. HubEngage can replace the tools you have outgrown, or connect to the ones you keep, like your payroll, HRIS, scheduling and collaboration tools, and bring them into one experience.

How do we reach employees who never log in?

Every message can go out by app, email and SMS at once, translated into each person’s language, and insights show who you reached, not just who signed in.

Is HubEngage secure?

HubEngage is SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR and HIPAA compliant, with SSO, SCIM and role-based access available on Enterprise.

What is HubEngage Intelligence, and is it included?

It is the layer that drafts, answers, automates and recommends across every hub. It is an add-on to Standard and Enterprise plans.
